mapper.select: SELECT a_no, a_date, a_content, q_no FROM answer WHERE q_no = #{q_no} ORDER BY a_no ASC
SELECT q_no, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM answer GROUP BY q_no
SELECT q_no, a_no, a_content, a_date FROM ( SELECT a.q_no, a.a_no, a.a_content, a.a_date, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.q_no ORDER BY a.a_no DESC) rn FROM answer a ) WHERE rn = 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO answer(a_no, a_date, a_content, q_no) VALUES( 'A' || LPAD(ANSWER_SEQ.NEXTVAL, 5, '0'), SYSDATE, #{a_content}, #{q_no} )
